feat(npc): guardian drop-in prefab (URP/Lit, ~1.7m, yaw 180) + GLB import meta

first_explanation.source: commit f3da6c2 message (repeated in 2658169 docs and 2de7310 spec as '混元正视导出朝 -Z')
first_explanation.contradicted_by: this audit (2026-10-05): GLB fronts face +Z as glTF specifies; UniGLTF reverseAxis default (Z) maps them to Unity -Z, so the cause is the importer convention, not the generator

Final build: all 24 GLB prefabs at 87fdd16 carry Model localRotation y=180 (verified in prefab YAML).

title: 24 GLB base-colour maps stored uncompressed (ARGB32 4096², full mips, 85.3 MiB each; 2,048 MiB = 69.6 % of build texture data)

first_observed.quote: 24 个 GLB 角色/道具在构建报告中各贡献约 89 MB 未压缩资源 (... 'NPC/道具 GLB 单体构建贡献低于 12 MB')

first_explanation.quote: 发布前将 GLB 处理链固定为“源模型 → 贴图降采样/合并 → 可发布 Prefab”，避免直接把超大内嵌纹理 GLB作为最终资产。 / 方案：GLB 在 Blender/导出链中把角色贴图降至 1024 ... 开启 GPU 纹理压缩
first_explanation.source: DESIGN/ProjectAudit_2026-07-15.md (external AI audit, adopted in commit b91ad03)
first_explanation.contradicted_by: Not contradicted, but incomplete: it blames oversized embedded textures; this audit locates the mechanism in UniGLTF creating embedded textures with LoadImage, bypassing Unity's texture importer (so no platform compression is applied).

visible_on_screen.why: texture format affects memory and build size (3.36 GiB build), not the image on screen

notes: SURPRISE: the paper's statement 'None of this appears in the game's commit history' is not exact — an external AI audit report committed on 2026-07-15 (b91ad03) recorded ~89 MB uncompressed per GLB and proposed compression (task 1 '压缩 GLB 角色与道具'); b91ad03 adopted other fixes but explicitly not this one, and no later commit acts on it. It did not mention CPU-readable copies or the dropped normal/MR maps. Introduced: the GLB is stored this way as soon as UniGLTF imports it (first GLB c21ea44); it enters Resources, hence every build, with the first prefab 953f004 (2026-06-23); the first build ever was made after bd3e7e3 (2026-07-03). UniGLTF itself was only vendored into the repo at ed13679 (2026-06-27); before that it lived untracked in the working copy (the GLB .meta in 953f004 already names a ScriptedImporter). to_observe measured from c21ea44 (from 953f004 it is 537.54 h). Final build: build_textures.json, 24 x 4096² format 5 (ARGB32), 13 mips, 89,478,484 B each.

title: Normal and metallic-roughness maps not referenced by the converted URP/Lit materials (dropped)

first_observed.quote: Each of the 24 assets kept one texture, its base colour: the import tool's material conversion copied the main texture and left the normal and metallic-roughness slots empty.

visible_on_screen.why: the loss of fine surface relief is not obviously a defect on screen (Hunyuan base colour already carries baked shading); no symptom was ever reported

notes: Mechanism: NPCModelSetupTool converts by copying mainTexture (TexProps _MainTex/_BaseMap/...) only — code present since ffe082d, applied to generated GLBs from c21ea44 (default ToonOutline, then URP/Lit from 2594401); first committed converted materials 953f004. 2594401 says URP/Lit 'carries the base-color texture correctly' and 2658169 records '3 贴图' per GLB, so both facts were written down on 2026-06-23 without anyone noting the other two maps were left out. Final build: all 28 NPC/prop material assets at 87fdd16 have _BumpMap and _MetallicGlossMap fileID 0 (companion xuanji_body.mat does have a normal map; its MR map was 'dropped by design' in 37e5b4e — a deliberate choice, not this defect). Datetime of the audit is the date only (2026-10-05, time set to 00:00 +08:00), so to_observe is approximate.
